lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Are you tellin' us the truth?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Is it at this time that, what do you do after you put her on the on the fire?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: We put the tires on there and the branches.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: He did. (Brendan nods “yes”) OK, now the fires going, she's on there, tell, tell, tell me what you're gonna what you're doin' now or what you guys do. I mean it's only five thirty right now, what are you guys doin'.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: After we put the tires and the branches on, we went to the house and went in there for a little bit and we went out and he was gonna take the jeep down in the pit so he did and that's when we covered it with branches and the hood.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Did you guys go out by the fire some more that night?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Where did this, this car seat come from?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Tell me how you guys got that.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: I went over to my house and got the, the golf cart and got, he went to go pick 'em up and we went over to get the car seat, and we put it by the fire, and waited for it to burn down, and we threw it on there, and we went to, to the jeep.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: OK so you, you went and got this car seat. Did you get anything else wh- when you had the golf cart.
